name: Camp Whitin
description_short: Weekly co-ed day camps run by the Whitin Community Center in Whitinsville, MA. Children ages 7-13 choose sport or activity camps with daily swimming, and children ages 4-6 attend Mini camps. Camp runs 9:00am-3:00pm, Monday-Friday.
swim_waterfront_notes: Campers ages 7-13 can swim daily in the WCC Competition Pool. Mini camps (ages 4-6) do not swim.
